lose: The dicer reaches {theirs} and sweeps the stakes in. "Better luck, traveller."
offer: Bones, traveller? Stakes on the table, and the first to {target} takes them.
one: You throw {a} and {b}. A one: your pot is lost.
play: Play, for what's in my hand.
stake: Your {stake} against my {theirs}. You throw first.
stake_empty: Nothing in your hand? Then we play for the fun of it. You throw first.
their_one: The dicer throws {a} and {b}. A one: their pot is lost.
their_throw: The dicer throws {a} and {b}. Their pot: {pot}.
throw: You throw {a} and {b}. Your pot: {pot}. Banked: you {mine}, the dicer {theirs}.
walked: The dicer gathers up the bones. "Come back when you mean it."
win: You reach {mine}. The dicer pushes the stakes across. "Fair's fair."
